# hostereo_applications (Data Source)

Marketplace applications (WordPress, Supabase, WireGuard, …). Use a version `id` as `application_version_id` and the `fields` as `app_fields`. Public; no API key needed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hostereo_applications" "all" {}

output "wordpress_versions" {
  value = one([for a in data.hostereo_applications.all.applications : a.versions if a.name == "WordPress"])
}
```
